questions.text: Describe a person who has had an important influence on your life.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a person who has had an important influence on your life. You should say: who this person is; how long you have known them; what they have done for you; and explain why this person has been important to you.

questions.text: Do you still keep in touch with this person?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you still keep in touch with this person?

questions.text: Who are the most common role models for young people in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a person who has influenced you. I'd like to discuss some more general questions about the people who influence us. Who are the most common role models for young people in your country?

questions.text: Do you think famous people have a responsibility to set a good example?

questions.text: How important is the influence of parents compared with the influence of friends?

questions.text: Can teachers still be good role models today? Why or why not?

questions.text: In what ways has social media changed the people that young people admire?
